sentences.text: I installed Ubuntu Linux, and I’m very impressed with it.
I previously tried to install Fedora Core 5, Fedora Core 5 had problems with starting up (would hang at udev loading), after a few hours when I got in, my sound and network didn’t work.
I installed Ubuntu, the installation for Ubuntu took about 5 minutes, and everything worked including my internet with no configuration.
It looks really cool and fast too.
I would highly suggest to get Ubuntu if you want to install Linux.
